title: I gave Opus 5.5 one prompt and six hours to visualize Invisible Cities
summary: A blog post describing an experiment where the author gave a single prompt to an AI model (referred to as 'Opus 5.5') and let it run for six hours to generate visualizations inspired by Italo Calvino's 'Invisible Cities.' The HN discussion (393 points, 194 comments) covers the model's autonomous output, prompt design, and long-horizon generation capabilities.
